event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Defensive rotation, semis cracked.
October UMich confidence printed 46.3 vs 47.8 fc while 1-year inflation expectations held 4.7, so the tape bought staples and sold chips into Wednesday's CPI (fc 0.60% m/m, 3.7% y/y). Positioning is the tell: 64% of names up but only 48% above the 200-DMA, and SOXX -2.60% is the wound, not the index.

INDICES — VIX 15.2, below its 15.6 20-day MA, VIXY -1.60%.
DIA +0.35%, RSP +0.07%, SPY -0.06%, IJR -0.06%, IWM -0.37%, IJH -0.37%, QQQ -0.70%, SOXX -2.60%. Large = small by 0.00pp; a dead-flat style tape masking a 2.95pp SPY-to-SOXX spread. Notable cross-asset: USO +1.91%, UUP +0.38%, GLD -0.63% — dollar up, gold down, oil the only real risk bid.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 0.4x, QQQ 0.7x.
SOXX ran 1.1x and DIA 0.9x while SPY traded at 0.4x — down-volume semis getting the attention and the down tape is distribution; SPY's 0.4x on -0.06% is a parked, low-conviction drift. XLRE 1.2x and XLC 1.1x gaining volume are the defensive accumulation side. Breadth: 318/179 adv/dec, 36% above the 50-DMA, 48% above the 200-DMA, up/down volume 1.24, 22 new 60-day highs against 22 lows — participation diverges from the calm index and skews mid-cap, not mega-cap.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +1.43%, XLP Staples +1.17%, XLC Comms +0.97%, XLRE Real Estate +0.75%, XLV Healthcare +0.69%, XLF Financials +0.58%, XLU Utilities +0.53%, XLB Materials +0.02%, XLI Industrials -0.06%, XLY Discretionary -0.51%, XLK Technology -1.22%.
Top industries: IHI +2.03%, USO +1.91%; bottom: WGMI -2.98%, URA -3.03%, MSOS -3.23%, DRAM -4.32%. Five-day SPDR flows confirm the drift: XLK +$1,500mm (100th pctile), XLE +$735mm (94th), XLC +$659mm (98th), with no GICS SPDR in net outflow. Money is leaving SPY -$3,154mm and SMH -$1,639mm (2nd pctile) while buying RSP +$824mm, IWM +$427mm and IGV +$263mm — rotation out of semis and index beta into equal-weight, small caps and software. Defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.98, QQQ 1.03; skew +5.0% and +7.1% = paid-for put protection.
Both sit near gamma: SPY spot vs GEX flip 785, QQQ vs 761 — dealer hedging amplifies any move below those levels. VIX 15.2 under its 20-day MA says complacency, while VIXEQ 39.1 vs VIX 15.2 is a historically wide dispersion gap — a stock-picker's, low-correlation tape.

CROSS-ASSET — WTI +1.91% and UMich inflation expectations at 4.7% into Wednesday's CPI is the chain: oil bid plus sticky inflation expectations plus a firm dollar pressure gold -0.63% and silver -0.78%. October 27-28 FOMC is next; Polymarket prices 80% no change, 20% for a 25bp hike (+4pp in five days) — a small but rising hike tail into the CPI print.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 54, Neutral.
Movers: MDT +3.90% on its announcement, TER -4.68% on its 24-slot Edge AI test launch, MP -6.03% on continued operating losses and soft estimates. Momentum: XLK best 20-day, XLRE worst; MTUM bull, IWF bear at -0.81z. Watch IWM given IJR/IJH at 0.5-0.6x volume and the Russell sitting -3.48% over 20 days, SOXX after 1.1x volume on -2.60% with SMH bleeding $1,639mm, and GLD into CPI with ATM IV 21.8%.
